verdict.rationale: The tax-returns help page documents a keyless path ('Express file online. No login required.'), so a filer can start a return without an account. However, the founder's primary flow, the business license application, requires creating a My DOR account first. The probe shows the secure portal sends keyless requests to login, but it only fetched robots.txt and did not test Express File, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: a documented keyless or UBI/file-number entry for the license application, detail on what Express File covers and how it is entered, and hands-on confirmation that the no-login path works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: Express file online. No login required.
Create an online account in our secure My DOR system. This account will also be used to file your taxes and make changes to your business.
